remaining_gaps.limits: No specific basket, cask, tub, vessel or capacity is implied.
Tool must be supplied by the selected process owner.
Material must be a committed finite batch supplied by the selected process owner.
Dormant storage does not imply a container; active process must supply exact compatibility and capacity refs.
A separate committed wreck entity/source ref and one shared finite remainder are required; this mapping creates neither.
